artifact.name: percentage_change_direction
artifact.content:
local function roundTo2(n: number): number
	local scaled = n * 100
	if scaled >= 0 then
		return math.floor(scaled + 0.5) / 100
	else
		return math.ceil(scaled - 0.5) / 100
	end
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initial = input.initial_value
	local current = input.current_value

	if initial == 0 then
		return {
			error = "invalid_initial_value",
			message = "initial_value must be non-zero to compute percentage change",
		}
	end

	local pct = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
	local pctRounded = roundTo2(pct)

	local direction: string
	if pctRounded > 0 then
		direction = "up"
	elseif pctRounded < 0 then
		direction = "down"
	else
		direction = "flat"
	end

	return {
		percentage_change = pctRounded,
		direction = direction,
	}
end
artifact.description: Computes percent change from initial_value to current_value (rounded to 2 decimals) and returns direction up/down/flat.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need to summarize how a value moved between two points with a percent change and direction indicator.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local listRes = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
	if not listRes.ok then
		return { error = listRes.error, message = listRes.message }
	end

	local notified: { string } = {}
	local failed: { string } = {}
	local sends = 0

	for _, c: CustomerRef in listRes.customers do
		if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
			if sends >= 10 then
				continue
			end
			sends += 1

			local text = "Hi " .. c.name .. ", we miss you!"
			local sendRes = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
			if sendRes.ok then
				table.insert(notified, c.id)
			else
				table.insert(failed, c.id)
			end
		end
	end

	return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: Lists customers in a segment and sends a miss-you message to those inactive for at least N days (max 10 sends).
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you want to re-engage inactive customers in a CRM segment with a personalized message.

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local function round2(x: number): number
		-- Half-away-from-zero rounding to 2 decimals
		if x >= 0 then
			return math.floor(x * 100 + 0.5) / 100
		else
			return math.ceil(x * 100 - 0.5) / 100
		end
	end

	local initial: number = input.initial_value
	local current: number = input.current_value

	if initial == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must be non-zero" }
	end

	local change: number = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
	local pct: number = round2(change)

	local direction: string
	if pct > 0 then
		direction = "up"
	elseif pct < 0 then
		direction = "down"
	else
		direction = "flat"
	end

	return { percentage_change = pct, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Computes percent change from initial to current (rounded to 2 decimals) and returns direction up/down/flat.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need a standardized percent-change metric and trend direction between two numeric values.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
local function shouldNotify(c: CustomerRef, inactiveDays: number): boolean
	return c.last_seen_days >= inactiveDays
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local listed = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
	if listed.ok == false then
		return { error = listed.error, message = listed.message }
	end

	local notified: { string } = {}
	local failed: { string } = {}
	local sends = 0

	for _, c: CustomerRef in listed.customers do
		if shouldNotify(c, input.inactive_days) then
			if sends >= 10 then
				break
			end
			sends += 1

			local text = "Hi " .. c.name .. ", we miss you!"
			local r = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
			if r.ok == false then
				table.insert(failed, c.id)
			else
				table.insert(notified, c.id)
			end
		end
	end

	return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end

artifact.name: percentage_change_direction
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initial: number = input.initial_value
	local current: number = input.current_value

	if initial == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must be non-zero to compute percentage change" }
	end

	local raw: number = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
	-- Round to 2 decimal places using magnitude-based rounding to handle negatives correctly
	local abs_times_100: number = math.abs(raw) * 100
	local rounded_mag: number = math.floor(abs_times_100 + 0.5) / 100
	local rounded: number = (raw >= 0) and rounded_mag or -rounded_mag

	local direction: string
	if rounded > 0 then
		direction = "up"
	elseif rounded < 0 then
		direction = "down"
	else
		direction = "flat"
	end

	return { percentage_change = rounded, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Computes percent change from initial to current, rounded to 2 decimals, plus up/down/flat direction.
